title: John D. Cott
clean_html:
John D. Cott

Preserved Primary Document • cott.htm

John D. Cott was born in Kent County Delaware sometime around 1804 according to the Delaware census records. He is believed to have been the son of John A. Cott and his wife, Mary. By 1839 he was married Sarah Ann Dean, the daughter of Jesse Dean Sr. and his wife, Rebecca. Sarah was born in Kent County DE. sometime around 1813. John and Sarah Cott are mentioned in the will of Sarah's father. Jesse Dean Sr. left Sarah's inheritance in trust for his daughter with Elisha DURHAM as trustee in order to protect it from the debts of her husband. Based on the COTT FAMILY BIBLE we know that : The children of John D. Cott and Sarah Ann Dean were : Catherine Cott (b. February 8, 1828 in DE) Martin Cott (b. September 13, 1830 in DE) Obediah Cott (b. Jan. 5, 1831 in DE - d. July 25, 1848 in DE) Levina (?) Cott (b. March 13, 1833 in DE) there is a marriage record for a "Lavinia Cott" to William DEAN in Cent County on Dec. 13, 1849 which may refer to this child Hevarin Cott (b. Oct. 8, 1834 in DE - d. May 20, 1852 in DE) William H. Cott (b. Feb. 12, 1835 in DE) John Wesley Cott (b. May 27, 1838 in DE - d. August 23, 1920 in MI) married Lydia Ann DEAN, daughter of Jesse and Hester Dean Deborah Cott (b. July 6, 1841 in DE) on January 7, 1858 she married Isaac DURHAM Rebecca Cott (b. Aug. 24, 1843 - d. May 15, 1913) on Jan. 11, 1866 she married Cornelius RIDGEWAY George F. Cott (b. June 27, 1845 in DE) Mary Elmira Cott (b. May 9, 1849 in DE - d. March 13, 1932 in DE) married Robert Carney / Absalom Saunders and Cash Mosley John D. Cott died in Kent County , DE on October 16, 1876. His wife, Sarah, died before him on June 5, 1867.
